HDFC Bank Appoints Former CEC Rajiv Kumar as Chairman

HDFC Bank has appointed former Chief Election Commissioner Rajiv Kumar as its new part-time Chairman. The appointment has received board approval. The bank also announced Puneet Sharma as its new Chief Financial Officer and Jigar Shah as General Counsel-Designate.
